generated.caption:
Is a magnitude 7 just a little stronger than a magnitude 6? Not even close. 🌍

The scale is logarithmic: each whole step is about 10x the ground motion on a seismogram and about 32x the energy released. But magnitude measures the earthquake itself, not the damage. Depth, distance, soil and building quality decide what you actually feel.

Magnitude is size. Intensity is shaking.
